main_body: Pine/bonsai-style tree: three layered green canopy pads on a leaning brown trunk
top_band: Lighter mid-green clumps across the upper rows of each canopy pad (about rows 1-8 on the main pad), grading to darker green underneath; no hard-edged flat band
evidence: As an organic form, each canopy pad reads as a lumpy volume. The lit upper surface is lighter and the underside is a darker green, with a dark shadow edge at the bottom of each pad. The trunk is a vertical form with a dark outline on the right. Because the canopy is irregular, there is no ruler-straight front edge line, but the top-to-underside value change is clear enough to read as 3/4.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 4 greens with some clump texture, but the clumps are blocky and less varied than the references' many-tone leaf clusters with highlights and gaps. The trunk is only about 3 browns, with large areas of flat mid-brown and a nearly neutral dark purple-black outline. The canopy outline is a very dark green, so the outline reads as mixed. The pads sit as simple blobs with little internal branch structure, so the piece looks thinner and flatter than the Beodeul trees.
